channel.title: City Record Digest — Agency Rules
channel.description: NYC City Record Agency Rules notices

item.title: Proposed Rule - Amendment of Rules relating to Natural Gas Alarms
item.description:
Buildings | Agency Rules | Public Hearings | Hearing: 2026-11-16
In plain English (machine-written): The Department of Buildings will hold a public hearing on Nov. 16, 2026, on a proposed rule amending its rules on natural gas alarms.

item.title: Notice of Adoption of Expedited Land Use Review Procedure and Affordable Housing Appeals Board Rules
item.description:
City Planning Commission | Agency Rules | Notice
In plain English (machine-written): The City Planning Commission has adopted rules setting an expedited land use review procedure and rules for an Affordable Housing Appeals Board, according to a notice published Oct. 15, 2026.

item.title: Department of City Planning Proposed Street Number Rulemaking
item.description:
City Planning | Agency Rules | Public Hearings | Hearing: 2026-11-17
In plain English (machine-written): The Department of City Planning will hold a public hearing on Nov. 17, 2026, on its proposed rule for street numbering.

item.title: Notice of Adoption DSNY Amendment of Penalty for Improper Disposal of Regulated Household Waste
item.description:
Sanitation | Agency Rules | Notice
In plain English (machine-written): The Department of Sanitation adopted a rule amending the penalty for improperly disposing of regulated household waste, according to a notice published Oct. 9, 2026.

item.title: Notice of Public Hearing and Opportunity to Comment on Proposed Rules relating to amendments for the Dining Out NYC program
item.description:
Transportation | Agency Rules | Public Hearings | Hearing: 2026-11-09
In plain English (machine-written): The Department of Transportation will hold a public hearing on Nov. 9, 2026, on proposed rules that would amend the Dining Out NYC program, and the public may comment on them.

item.title: Amendment of Rules Relating to Lead Dust
item.description:
Health and Mental Hygiene | Agency Rules | Notice

item.title: Amendment of Rules Relating to Syndromic Surveillance
item.description:
Health and Mental Hygiene | Agency Rules | Public Hearings | Hearing: 2026-11-05
In plain English (machine-written): The Department of Health and Mental Hygiene will hold a public hearing on Nov. 5, 2026, on proposed amendments to its rules on syndromic surveillance, which is the monitoring of health data to track disease patterns.

item.title: Proposed Rule - Amendment of Rules relating to Ancillary Dwelling Units
item.description:
Buildings | Agency Rules | Public Hearings | Hearing: 2026-11-04

item.title: Extension of Time to File and Expansion of Processes Permanent Rule Amendment of Rule Relating to Surcharge on Certain Non-Primary Residences

item.title: The Landmarks Preservation Commission is proposing to amend the various rules relating to staff approval for work on designated properties.
item.description:
Landmarks Preservation Commission | Agency Rules | Public Hearings | Hearing: 2026-11-17

item.title: CCHR NOTICE OF ADOPTION OF FINAL CERTIFIED RULE RE EMPLOYMENT DISCRIMINATION ON THE BASIS OF CRIMINAL HISTORY, CONTENTS OF COMPLAINTS, SERVICE OF APPEAL REQUESTS, AND PUBLIC ACCOMMODATIONS REQUESTS FOR EXEMPTIONS BASED ON GENDER AND AGE
item.description:
Commission on Human Rights | Agency Rules | Notice
In plain English (machine-written): The New York City Commission on Human Rights has adopted final rules on employment discrimination based on criminal history, complaint contents, service of appeals, and requests for exemptions from public accommodation rules based on gender and age.

item.title: DCWP NOA General Vending Waitlist

Consumer and Worker Protection | Agency Rules | Notice

item.title: Amendment of Rules Relating to Vital Records
item.description:
Health and Mental Hygiene | Agency Rules | Notice
In plain English (machine-written): The Department of Health and Mental Hygiene has proposed amendments to its rules relating to vital records, such as birth and death certificates.

item.title: DSNY Final Rule re Implementation Dates re Brooklyn East Manhattan Northeast Queens West and Manhattan West CWZ

Sanitation | Agency Rules | Notice

item.title: Notice of Public Hearing and Opportunity to Comment on Proposed Amendments to Chapter 12 of Title 68 of the Rules of the City of New York Regarding the Fair Fares NYC Program
